_about: Can search find answers that exist only in documents written in an Indian language? Both documents are in Marathi. Each question is asked in English, as the planner would send it, and in Marathi, as a farmer would. 'any' is what the passage must contain. It uses the documents' own spelling, including letters damaged by the PDF's fonts. Labels were written from the documents before any search ran on them. The Marathi questions were written by Claude and haven't been checked by a Marathi speaker.
